profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Johnson & Johnson
profile.summary:
**Open to Engineering Leadership opportunities**

Technical Lead demonstrating proven abilities to lead a project from inception to deploy and post production support in a distributed system environment. Proven ownership and successful project management track record to ensure solid deliverability. Experience working with distributed workforce and leading and managing offshore teams. 

Looking for Engineering opportunities to utilize my technical skills along with my management abilities and adaptability to have a broader impact on the business.

Key skills: Software Design and Architecture, Service oriented architecture (SOA) , Object oriented programming,  REST APIs, Distributed Systems, Design for Scale, SSO, SAML, oAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), RBAC, 3rd party integrations, Cross functional project planning and execution, Agile, Scrum, Project execution, Technical Leadership

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Expert in Authentication Frameworks including - SSO, OAuth, SAML, RBAC
- Integrations with Customers such as Defense agencies and Federal Government

Experienced in  Enterprise and Subscription based Alerting and Notifications SaaS Platform 
- Self service Alerting platform - subscriptions, management, targeted alerting
- Enterprise level Alerts management platform 
- Alerts and Notifications include - SMS, Voice, Email, Push notifications, Pager, Sirens and similar technologies.

Mentors offshore team members
- Agile development philosophy
- Ensuring quality standards through code reviews etc.



Primary Technologies include Object oriented Programming, Relational databases, Microservices, Restful architecture , SSO , SAML,  OAuth, SaaS, Distributed Systems , Queuing frameworks- Kafka

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained and developed new features for TENS(Telephone Emergency Notification System)
• Collect desired geographical objects using polygons and convert it to WKT format supported by postGIS for processing end user request
• Designed and developed Text Messaging system, which also included 3rd party integration
• Designed and developed SAND (Specialized Notification System)
• Developed In-house Reporting for TENS and Text Messaging through 3rd party APIs
• Provided on call support on production bug fixes and hotpatches
• Work done was used during the Chevron Refinery Incident (Contra Costa County); it is also being actively used for Tsunami warnings in Hawaii as well as other smaller incidents
• Responsibilities included the Contra Costa County Community Warning System and Hawaii County Civil Defense Agency Warning System

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Worked on an in-house project for my under graduate school.
- Developed an application for managing an online telephone directory for all staff, faculty  and students of the school.
- Online Book Reservation System ­ 
  Developed an online book reservation /check out system for library.
